table.name: concert
table.purpose: One row per concert event, identifying the concert, its name/theme, the year, and the stadium where it takes place. Linked to singers via singer_in_concert and to venues via stadium.

Stadium_ID.name: Stadium_ID
Stadium_ID.description: Identifier of the stadium hosting the concert; references stadium.Stadium_ID (many concerts per stadium).

Theme.name: Theme
Theme.description: Theme of the concert; values are song titles or 'Free choice' (performer picks their own song), suggesting a TV singing-competition context.

Year.name: Year
Year.description: Year the concert took place (2014 or 2015).

concert_ID.name: concert_ID
concert_ID.description: Primary key identifying the concert; referenced by singer_in_concert.concert_ID to link singers to concerts.

concert_Name.name: concert_Name
concert_Name.description: Name/label of the concert event (e.g. 'Auditions', 'Home Visits', 'Super bootcamp', 'Week 1'), consistent with stages of a singing-competition show.

table.name: singer
table.purpose: Directory of singers, each with one signature song, its release year, age, country of origin and gender. Referenced by singer_in_concert, which links singers to concerts held in stadiums.

Age.name: age
Age.description: Age of the singer in years (25-52).

Country.name: country
Country.description: Country of origin of the singer (e.g. France, Netherlands, United States).

Is_male.name: is_male
Is_male.description: Gender flag stored as 'T'/'F'; T = male, F = female.

Name.name: name
Name.description: Full name or stage name of the singer (e.g. 'Timbaland', 'Rose White').

Singer_ID.name: singer_id
Singer_ID.description: Primary key identifying the singer; referenced by singer_in_concert.Singer_ID.

Song_Name.name: song_name
Song_Name.description: Name of the singer's (signature) song, e.g. 'Hey Oh', 'Gentleman'.

Song_release_year.name: song_release_year
Song_release_year.description: Year the song was released (1992-2016), stored as text.

table.name: singer_in_concert
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking singers to the concerts they perform in (many-to-many between singer and concert).

Singer_ID.name: Singer_ID
Singer_ID.description: Identifier of the singer performing in the concert; references singer.Singer_ID (many-to-one).

concert_ID.name: concert_ID
concert_ID.description: Identifier of the concert; references concert.concert_ID (many-to-one).

table.name: stadium
table.purpose: One row per stadium (Scottish football grounds) hosting concerts; referenced by concert.Stadium_ID. Contains name, home team/location, capacity, and attendance statistics (highest, lowest, average).

Average.name: average_attendance
Average.description: Average attendance at the stadium; always between Lowest and Highest, consistent with attendance figures.

Capacity.name: capacity
Capacity.description: Seating/standing capacity of the stadium (2000 to 52500; Hampden Park's 52500 matches its real capacity).

Highest.name: highest_attendance
Highest.description: Highest recorded attendance at the stadium; always >= Average and Lowest.

Location.name: home_team
Location.description: Despite the name 'Location', values are football club names (Ayr United, East Fife, Queen's Park), i.e. the team based at the stadium, not a city. Could alternatively be read as the club-as-location label.

Lowest.name: lowest_attendance
Lowest.description: Lowest recorded attendance at the stadium; always <= Average and Highest.

Name.name: stadium_name
Name.description: Name of the stadium (e.g. Hampden Park, Somerset Park).

Stadium_ID.name: stadium_id
Stadium_ID.description: Primary key identifying the stadium; referenced by concert.Stadium_ID.
